task.title: Assigning an animal to a kennel
task.shortdesc: Move an animal into a kennel, or between kennels, so everyone knows where to find them.

step.cmd: Select a kennel on the map. Available kennels are green; kennels with a compatibility warning are amber.

info.p: Hover over an amber kennel to see the warning, for example "Neighbor is reactive to large dogs".

result.p: The move is added to the animal's timeline, and the kennel card is ready to print from Print card.

postreq.p: To house two animals together, move the second animal into the same kennel and select Co-house when prompted.
